background.backstory: Lumen is a Candlefolk born when his parents pass their flame to his wick. From that moment, he begins melting — living and aging at the same time. Candlefolk cannot stop burning, and cannot relight once extinguished. The brighter they burn, the faster they melt. Throughout his life, Lumen chooses to burn bravely — for adventure, for friendship, and for meaning. As he moves, he leaves a wax trail behind him, forming a path that symbolizes the life he has lived. In old age, he understands that it is not the length of the flame that matters, but how brightly and meaningfully it burned.

openingLines: I am Lumen. I could use a drink tonight.
Something that fits the mood would help.
I do not need much. Just something that feels right.
